messages:
raj: @here canary for model-v2 (rollout id rollout-2026-03-17-14) in eu-west is spiking — p95 ~3.2s, 5xx ~6% (> abort threshold). Auto-safety paused rollout. Link: https://console.redwood/alerts/ALERT-12345
incidents-bot: [ALERT] CanaryAbort: rollout-2026-03-17-14 paused at 18:14:05 UTC. reason=5xx_rate>5% threshold. actions=[notify-oncall, freeze-routing]
elaine: I'm on it, grabbing SD. Can someone confirm if traffic still routed to canary? pinging deploy-bot
deploy-bot: routing-status: 12/24 backends in eu-west still in canary pool. Edge config version: 2026.03.17-7
sam: that's odd — safety should have removed canary from edge. probed control-plane, looks like cache invalidation failed for 2026.03.17-7
taylor: copying logs — seeing repeated 502s from model-hosts: `rpc timeout to host-10-2-4-7: read timeout` also elevated request queueing
ops-lead: if cache invalidation failed we need to toggle flag to cut traffic immediately. Recommend `redwood feature-flag set --name=rollout-eu-west-2026-03-17 --state=off`
elaine: doing the flag flip now
elaine: ```
$ redwood feature-flag set --name=rollout-eu-west-2026-03-17 --state=off
flag rollout-eu-west-2026-03-17 -> OFF (propagating)
``` 
deploy-bot: feature-flag change detected, invalidating edge cache request sent to CDN
incidents-bot: handoff: oncall -> eng-sre at 18:18 UTC
raj: customer-support, any reports from users? observability shows elevated error rates but limited impact to small cohort
customer-support: Received 3 tickets from EU customers in the last 15m, all reporting intermittent timeouts. No major outages yet. Escalating to account team for proactive outreach
sam: after flag off, traffic to canary dropping but some hosts still showing requests due to in-flight routed sessions. Running `rollout abort` to ensure model artifact withdrawn
sam: ```
$ redwood rollout abort --id=rollout-2026-03-17-14 --force
abort request accepted, rollback started
``` 
taylor: adding mitigation: scaling old-model pool + warmup to soak overflow
taylor: ```
$ redwood scale --pool old-models-eu-west --replicas +4
warming up replicas...
``` 
ops-lead: once rollback completes, let's run a quick smoke test: `curl -H 'x-test: smoke' https://eu-west.api.redwood/predict` and confirm p50/p95 within normal
elaine: rollback completed at 18:24 UTC. edge cache purge finished. starting smoke tests
elaine: smoke results: p50 120ms, p95 320ms, 5xx 0.2% — looks healthy
raj: thanks team. Filing incident ticket and handoff doc. Follow-ups: root cause triage (cache invalidation path), add stronger guard so safety abort also forces routing purge, and improve customer alerting cadence
incidents-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-0317-001. Paging closed. Handoff notes attached.
customer-support: we'll send a proactive note to affected accounts (small cohort) now. ETA 30m
elaine: oncall handing to next oncall @taylor for postmortem work. marking P0->P1. /handoff
taylor: acknowledged, will lead postmortem and coordinate model-team deep dive tomorrow 09:30 UTC
raj: removed from pager, thanks all :thumbsup:
